findings.summary: The result is partial only because the sandbox denied the test runner's local socket; the suite passes outside it and on every platform's check.

body.summary: TALLY-01's second attempt: yes to the exit question. tally prints the lines, words and characters of files and of standard input, decoding both as UTF-8 on every platform; tests cover empty input, input without a final line break, text outside ASCII, a byte-order mark and an unreadable file; the README describes the output and the counting rules. The reviewer ran all 54 tests, and the pull request's checks pass on Linux, macOS and Windows at e696403.
